metadata.text:
HP: 2 | AT: 1

↷: Play an additional
loot card this turn.
When you start the game, look at
the top 3 cards of the treasure
deck, choose one, it becomes your
starting item and gains eternal.
Put the rest on the bottom of
the deck in any order.
metadata.notes: Included with The Binding of Isaac: Repentance - Leviathan Edition from Nicalis.
